summary: AdSupport gives an app the per-device advertising identifier, which is gated by Apple's App Tracking Transparency prompt. BifrOSt has no advertising identifier and no tracking prompt, so there is no counterpart to expose.

features.note: The Linux desktop has no per-device ad ID; the Bluetooth ID-like fields in springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs are unrelated
Apple policy tied to advertising; BifrOSt apps request capabilities through manifest permissions (springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/manifest.toml)
